$comment: Ceilings for the published Pages site (all files, gzip level Optimal). Real AOT (wasm-tools 10.0.14, local publish): 59 files / 31.9 MB raw / 10.4 MB gzip with every assembly AOT-compiled; 59 files / 25.7 MB raw / 8.65 MB gzip / 16.1 MB native module with EditorAotInterpret=bcl (the default) and the unused ICU bundles removed. The public site before these changes: 56 files / ~10.6 MB gzip; non-AOT measured 193 files / 29.0 MB raw / 11.2 MB gzip (decimal MB). Lower these when a build proves a smaller payload; never raise without a measured reason.
